original_test_intent: Generate a new RSA-4096 client key, authorize only its public key on the approved server account and prove the exact remote login succeeds using public-key authentication without password fallback.
original_method: Verify client/server/account and pinned host fingerprint; choose unused disposable key path and passphrase policy; preserve authorized_keys baseline; generate RSA-4096; record public fingerprint only; authorize through protected channel; run strict BatchMode/IdentitiesOnly login to real target; confirm authentication method; revoke and restore.
manual_activity: Account owner approves target, disposable scope, host fingerprint, passphrase/secret channel and revocation; agent may perform the exact bounded key lifecycle.
required_inputs: Approved client/server/account identities and host fingerprint
Unused disposable RSA-4096 key path and passphrase policy
Alternate access and redacted evidence storage
safety_requirements: Never log private key or passphrase
Revoke temporary key and stop on identity/access mismatch; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Generate and fingerprint disposable public key
Authorize and run strict real-target BatchMode proof

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Hard-coded id_ed25519 and localhost only verify a pre-existing local condition; sshpass and StrictHostKeyChecking=no violate the required secure target workflow.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Generate RSA-4096 at an approved unused path, securely add only its public key to the exact server, then use strict host checking plus BatchMode/IdentitiesOnly against that real target and revoke afterward.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: RSA 4096, key listing, server authorization, passwordless remote login and 10/5-minute allocations are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a disposable, fingerprint-bound SSH key lifecycle with strict host verification, explicit authentication-method proof and cleanup audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes plaintext password/host bypass and adds non-overwrite, least privilege, redaction and revocation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Loopback with an existing Ed25519 key cannot substitute for generating/copying/testing the requested RSA key.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Authorization creates persistent access and mishandled private material or cleanup can create security exposure.

project_override_considerations: Security owner must decide RSA policy, passphrase requirement, authorized_keys restrictions, key lifetime and whether source script repository path/version is approved.
expected_evidence: Redacted key path/permissions and RSA public fingerprint
Strict BatchMode/IdentitiesOnly real-target output and auth method

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source generates/copies a new RSA key and tests the real server; DeepSeek inspects an existing Ed25519 key and logs into localhost, so it does not cover the intended lifecycle.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if exact owner/target/fingerprint, safe key path/secret channel, authorization/revocation or alternate access cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row401 Wistron-OS-00016-V002: approve disposable client/server/account and pinned host fingerprint, RSA-4096 key path/passphrase/authorized_keys restrictions, secure initial authorization channel, alternate access, evidence redaction, cleanup/revocation owner and exact script provenance/version if used.

review_improvement: Restores the complete requested credential lifecycle and makes persistent access creation bounded, attributable and reversible.
independent_technical_reasoning: Passwordless success is only meaningful if the newly generated key is the credential used on the intended server. BatchMode plus IdentitiesOnly and verbose authentication evidence distinguishes that from agent-loaded keys or password fallback, while revocation proves the test did not leave unauthorized access.
